title: Claim-file merge driver's mutation control is dead: its null control fails, 0 of 16 mutants reached
claim: dev/audit/harnesses/claim_merge_mutants.py, the one control that empties each rule of the claimnotes merge driver, fails its own null control at the baseline (baseline_pass=0) and so reaches 0 of its 16 mutants; giving its copy custom_components/ restores 16 of 16 killed.
mechanism: The harness copies only tests/ and .gitattributes into its temp tree, then imports tests/harness.py, which since aa631f7c5d (2026-11-11) lists custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/translations at import. The import raises FileNotFoundError, the null control exits 1, and main() returns before any mutant. Nothing wires the harness (no workflow, no self-test step), so the break was silent.

evidence.unit: mutants reached by the claim driver's mutation control
evidence.contention_note: box shared (load1 10.3); return codes and kill counts, contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: dev/audit/harnesses/claim_merge_mutants.py:main (run_section), over tests/entities.py's claim-file merge-driver section and tests/env_drift.py:merge_claim_file

perturbation.change: the harness's temp copy also takes custom_components/ (claim_control.py --perturb wraps its shutil.copytree)

metric_definition: Mutants of tests/env_drift.py's claimnotes driver that claim_merge_mutants.py actually runs (killed + survived) after its unmutated null control.
phenomenon_property: A control that copies a partial tree carries every path its imports read at load time, and a control nobody runs on a schedule is wired somewhere that reddens when its null control fails.

null_control.note: with the missing directory supplied, the same control kills every mutant, so 0 is the copy's defect and not the driver's

proposed_fix_scope: Copy custom_components/ (or the translations directory) into the harness's temp tree, and wire the harness as a governance.yml instrument-self-tests step (or a tests/entities.py arm) so a red null control is seen.
